proves.claim: A remote claim the served board accepts launches the claim beater once with the remote binding, and a refused claim launches none.

cli.io-remote-moves.claim-starts-beater.why: Without it, a URL-joined seat's claim could be swept two minutes after it is taken, with no test noticing.

proves.claim: A remote submit or release that succeeds removes the beater lock, so the beater stops.

cli.io-remote-moves.submit-stops-beater.why: Without it, a beater could keep beating a seat that no longer holds a claim.
